name: Penetration Testing
title: Penetration Testing in Uzbekistan | OSEC.uz
desc: Manual penetration testing for web applications, APIs, mobile apps, networks and Active Directory by the OSEC.uz team in Uzbekistan. Validated findings with a clear fix path.
lead: OSEC.uz tests whether weaknesses in your applications, APIs and networks combine into realistic attack paths, then documents each one with technical evidence and a prioritized fix.
covers: REST and GraphQL APIs, including fintech and payment flows
Active Directory and identity attack paths
gets: A scoped test plan agreed before work starts
Manual testing on top of automated scanning
Reproducible proof for every validated finding
Remediation guidance ranked by real-world impact
uz: Veb-ilovalar, API, mobil ilovalar, tarmoq va Active Directory'ni qo'lda sinash. Har bir topilma dalil va tuzatish yo'li bilan taqdim etiladi.

name: Red Teaming
title: Red Team Assessments in Uzbekistan | OSEC.uz
desc: Objective-based red team assessments and adversary emulation by OSEC.uz. Test your people, process and detection against a realistic attacker, not a checklist.
h1: Red teaming against a real adversary model.
lead: A red team assessment asks one question: could an attacker reach what matters to you, and would you notice? OSEC.uz emulates realistic adversary tradecraft against agreed objectives and reports what worked, what was detected, and what to change.
covers: Endpoint detection and response (EDR) evasion research
gets: Rules of engagement and objectives defined up front
Attack narrative mapped to MITRE ATT&CK
uz: Real hujumchi modeliga qarshi maqsadga yo'naltirilgan baholash: himoyangiz hujumni payqaydimi?

name: Attack Surface Validation
title: Attack Surface Validation & Discovery | OSEC.uz
desc: Continuous attack surface discovery and validation by OSEC.uz: find exposed services, test whether they are exploitable, and focus remediation on what an attacker can actually reach.
h1: Don't count vulnerabilities. Validate attack paths.
lead: Scanners list issues; attackers chain them. OSEC.uz maps your external and internal surface, tests which exposures are reachable and exploitable, and shows the path an attacker would take.
gets: An inventory of what is actually exposed
Findings ranked by attack path, not by scanner score
A route to remediation your engineers can act on
uz: Zaifliklarni sanash emas, balki hujumchi bosib o'tishi mumkin bo'lgan haqiqiy yo'llarni tekshirish.

lead: OSEC.uz researches vulnerabilities and attacker tradecraft directly, from endpoint evasion to mobile and hardware forensics, and publishes the results with coordinated disclosure.
